nodes.label: Vendored pdf-lib
nodes.rationale: CloudTAK's Docker image runs npm install only in api/web, then lints, typechecks, and builds ./plugins/. Plugin package.json dependencies are not installed, so a bare import of pdf-lib fails vue-tsc. Vendoring the eslint-disabled ESM bundle and a minimal d.ts keeps ICS 234 PDF export (src/lib/ics234Pdf.ts) self-contained with no CloudTAK changes. The source map line is stripped because the map is not vendored.

nodes.label: Vendored vue-hasty-team
nodes.rationale: Vendored from @tak-ps/vue-hasty-team v3.70.0 for the same Docker constraint, so the Organization tab does not need a peer that is absent at build time. Patched with explicit column widths so SVG connectors align on 3-wide sibling rows, and wheel zoom clamped to 0.2-3 so CSS scale never goes negative and inverts the chart. Prefer contributing fixes upstream, then refreshing the copy.
